newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sees no 97/98 grain export tender start today.
newsitem.headline: EU sees no 97/98 grain export tender start today.

text.p: The European Union is unlikely to decide to open 1997/98 (July/June) grain export tenders at today's weekly meeting of the cereals management committee, European Commission sources said on Thursday.
"It's not expected. The meeting is routine," said a source.
On Tuesday, EU agricultural director general Guy Legras said in Luxembourg that Brussels was "not in a hurry" to open the tenders.

The European Commission, mindful of low intervention stocks and anxious to ensure adequate supplies at affordable prices for domestic consumers, wants to have a clearer picture of the grain harvest outlook before launching 1997/98 exports.
